title: Richard Brome Online
author: Richard Brome
institution: Royal Holloway, University of London and Digital Humanities Institute, Sheffield (general editor Richard Cave)
notes: Edition of the fifteen surviving plays of Richard Brome and The Late Lancashire Witches (with Heywood), with the original quarto or octavo text and an annotated modern-spelling text side by side, essays, a glossary, stage histories and recorded workshop performances. Counts are ours: 16 plays and about 472,000 words in the original-spelling text pages (including title pages and dedications; the modernised version is not counted). Published 2010 (AHRC-funded); no later update seen. Copyright is held by Royal Holloway.
